column1: 分母
column2: denominator

column2: The number below the line in a fraction. In class: 통분해서 분모를 같게 해 봅시다. (Find the common denominator.)

column1: 小数
column2: decimal

column1: 0.5 のような数。授業では 4분의 1을 소수로 써 봅시다.(1/4を小数で書こう)
column2: A number like 0.5. In class: 4분의 1을 소수로 써 봅시다. (Write one quarter as a decimal.)

column1: 平方根
column2: square root

column1: 2乗するとその数になる数。授業では 9의 제곱근은 3이에요.(9の平方根は3)
column2: The number that, multiplied by itself, gives the number. In class: 9의 제곱근은 3이에요. (The square root of nine is three.)

column1: 文字(変数)
column2: variable

column1: x や y のように、いろいろな値をとる文字。授業では 여기서 x는 변수예요.(ここでは x が変数)
column2: A letter that stands for a number. In class: 여기서 x는 변수예요. (Here, x is a variable.)

column1: 角
column2: angle

column1: 2本の線が作る開き。授業では 각도기로 각을 재 봅시다.(分度器で角をはかろう)
column2: The space between two lines that meet. In class: 각도기로 각을 재 봅시다. (Measure the angle with a protractor.)

column1: 数学 1
column2: Math 1

column1: 平行な
column2: parallel

column1: どこまでのばしても交わらないこと。授業では 이 두 직선은 평행해요.(この2本の線は平行)
column2: Never meeting, like the two rails of a track. In class: 이 두 직선은 평행해요. (These two lines are parallel.)

column1: 面積
column2: area

column1: 広さ。授業では 직사각형의 넓이를 구해 봅시다.(長方形の面積を求めよう)
column2: The size of a flat surface. In class: 직사각형의 넓이를 구해 봅시다. (Find the area of the rectangle.)

column1: 半径
column2: radius

column1: 円の中心から円周までの長さ。授業では 반지름은 지름의 절반이에요.(半径は直径の半分)
column2: The distance from the center of a circle to its edge. In class: 반지름은 지름의 절반이에요. (The radius is half of the diameter.)

column1: 体積
column2: volume

column1: 立体の大きさ。授業では 정육면체의 부피를 구해 봅시다.(立方体の体積を求めよう)
column2: The amount of space inside a solid. In class: 정육면체의 부피를 구해 봅시다. (Find the volume of the cube.)

column1: 関数
column2: function

column1: xが決まるとyがただ1つ決まる関係。授業では y는 x의 함수예요.(yはxの関数)
column2: A rule where each x gives one y. In class: y는 x의 함수예요. (y is a function of x.)

column1: 座標
column2: coordinates

column1: 点の位置を表す数の組。授業では 점 P의 좌표를 써 봅시다.(点Pの座標を書こう)
column2: The pair of numbers that shows where a point is. In class: 점 P의 좌표를 써 봅시다. (Write the coordinates of point P.)

column1: 確率
column2: probability

column1: あることが起こる割合。授業では 앞면이 나올 확률은 얼마일까요?(表が出る確率は?)
column2: How likely something is to happen. In class: 앞면이 나올 확률은 얼마일까요? (What is the probability of getting heads?)

column1: 平均値
column2: mean

column1: 全部たして個数でわった値。授業では 자료의 평균을 계산해 봅시다.(データの平均値を計算しよう)
column2: The total divided by the number of values. In class: 자료의 평균을 계산해 봅시다. (Calculate the mean of the data.)

column1: 数学 2
column2: Math 2

column1: 力
column2: force

column1: 物を押したり引いたりするはたらき。単位は N(ニュートン)。授業では 힘을 화살표로 나타내 봅시다.(力を矢印で表そう)
column2: A push or a pull. In class: 힘을 화살표로 나타내 봅시다. (Draw an arrow to show the force.)

column1: 摩擦
column2: friction

column1: ふれ合う面で動きをじゃまする力。授業では 마찰 때문에 상자가 느려져요.(摩擦で箱がおそくなる)
column2: The force that slows things rubbing together. In class: 마찰 때문에 상자가 느려져요. (Friction slows the box down.)

column1: 速さ
column2: speed

column1: 距離÷時間。授業では 평균 속력을 계산해 봅시다.(平均の速さを計算しよう)
column2: Distance divided by time. In class: 평균 속력을 계산해 봅시다. (Calculate the average speed.)

column1: 電流
column2: electric current

column1: 電気の流れ。単位は A(アンペア)。授業では 전류계로 전류를 재 봅시다.(電流計で電流をはかろう)
column2: The flow of electricity. In class: 전류계로 전류를 재 봅시다. (Measure the current with an ammeter.)

column1: 電圧
column2: voltage

column1: 電流を流そうとするはたらき。単位は V(ボルト)。授業では 전압계는 병렬로 연결해요.(電圧計は並列につなごう)
column2: The push that moves electric current. In class: 전압계는 병렬로 연결해요. (Connect the voltmeter in parallel.)

column1: 磁界
column2: magnetic field

column1: 磁石の力がはたらく空間。授業では 철가루로 자기장을 확인해 봅시다.(鉄粉で磁界のようすを見よう)
column2: The area where a magnet has an effect. In class: 철가루로 자기장을 확인해 봅시다. (Use iron filings to see the magnetic field.)

column1: 元素
column2: element

column1: 物質をつくるもとになる成分。授業では 주기율표에서 그 원소를 찾아봅시다.(周期表でその元素を探そう)
column2: A substance made of only one kind of atom. In class: 주기율표에서 그 원소를 찾아봅시다. (Find the element on the periodic table.)

column1: 原子
column2: atom

column1: 物質をつくる、とても小さなつぶ。授業では 원자는 너무 작아서 보이지 않아요.(原子は小さすぎて見えない)
column2: The tiny unit that everything is made of. In class: 원자는 너무 작아서 보이지 않아요. (Atoms are too small to see.)

column1: 理科 1
column2: Science 1

column1: 酸
column2: acid

column1: 水溶液が酸性を示す物質。授業では 레몬즙은 산성이에요.(レモン汁は酸)
column2: A substance that turns blue litmus paper red. In class: 레몬즙은 산성이에요. (Lemon juice is an acid.)

column1: 呼吸
column2: respiration

column1: 細胞が栄養分からエネルギーを取り出すはたらき。授業では 호흡으로 에너지를 얻어요.(呼吸でエネルギーが取り出される)
column2: How living things get energy from food. In class: 호흡으로 에너지를 얻어요. (Respiration releases energy.)

column1: 消化
column2: digestion

column1: 食べ物を体に吸収できる形に分解すること。授業では 소화는 입에서 시작돼요.(消化は口から始まる)
column2: Breaking food down so the body can use it. In class: 소화는 입에서 시작돼요. (Digestion starts in the mouth.)

column1: 遺伝子
column2: gene

column1: 親から子に伝わる特徴のもと。授業では 유전자는 부모에게서 자녀에게 전해져요.(遺伝子は親から子に伝わる)
column2: The part of a cell that carries traits from parents. In class: 유전자는 부모에게서 자녀에게 전해져요. (Genes are passed from parents to children.)

column1: 食物連鎖
column2: food chain

column1: 「食べる・食べられる」のつながり。授業では 숲의 먹이 사슬을 그려 봅시다.(森の食物連鎖をかこう)
column2: The line of who eats whom in nature. In class: 숲의 먹이 사슬을 그려 봅시다. (Draw a food chain for the forest.)

column1: 火山
column2: volcano

column1: マグマがふき出してできた山。授業では 이 화산은 지금도 활동하고 있어요.(この火山は今も活動している)
column2: A mountain where magma comes out. In class: 이 화산은 지금도 활동하고 있어요. (This volcano is still active.)

column1: 化石
column2: fossil

column1: 大昔の生物の死がいや跡が残ったもの。授業では 화석으로 옛날 생물을 알 수 있어요.(化石から大昔の生物がわかる)
column2: What is left of a living thing from long ago, turned to rock. In class: 화석으로 옛날 생물을 알 수 있어요. (Fossils tell us about ancient life.)

column1: 太陽系
column2: solar system

column1: 太陽とそのまわりを回る天体の集まり。授業では 태양계에는 행성이 8개 있어요.(太陽系には8つの惑星がある)
column2: The Sun and everything that goes around it. In class: 태양계에는 행성이 8개 있어요. (There are eight planets in the solar system.)

column1: 理科 2
column2: Science 2

column1: 緯度
column2: latitude

column1: 赤道から北や南へどれだけ離れているか。授業では 도쿄는 북위 약 36도에 있어요.(東京は北緯約36度にある)
column2: How far north or south of the equator. In class: 도쿄는 북위 약 36도에 있어요. (Tokyo is at about 36 degrees north latitude.)

column1: 半島
column2: peninsula

column1: 三方を海に囲まれた陸地。授業では 이탈리아는 장화 모양의 긴 반도예요.(イタリアはブーツの形をした長い半島だ)
column2: Land with the sea on three sides. In class: 이탈리아는 장화 모양의 긴 반도예요. (Italy is a long peninsula shaped like a boot.)

column1: 人口密度
column2: population density

column1: 一定の面積に何人住んでいるか。授業では 도쿄는 인구 밀도가 아주 높아요.(東京は人口密度がとても高い)
column2: How many people live in a given area. In class: 도쿄는 인구 밀도가 아주 높아요. (Tokyo has a very high population density.)

column1: 輸出(する)
column2: export

column1: 国内のものを外国に売ること。授業では 일본은 자동차를 많이 수출해요.(日本はたくさんの車を輸出している)
column2: To sell goods to other countries. In class: 일본은 자동차를 많이 수출해요. (Japan exports a lot of cars.)

column1: 輸入(する)
column2: import

column1: 外国のものを国内に買い入れること。授業では 일본의 밀은 대부분 수입한 거예요.(日本の小麦のほとんどは輸入されている)
column2: To buy goods from other countries. In class: 일본의 밀은 대부분 수입한 거예요. (Most of the wheat in Japan is imported.)

column1: 農業
column2: agriculture

column1: 作物を育てたり家畜を飼ったりする仕事。授業では 이 지역에서는 농업이 중요해요.(この地域では農業が大切だ)
column2: Growing crops and raising animals. In class: 이 지역에서는 농업이 중요해요. (Agriculture is important in this region.)

column1: 文明
column2: civilization

column1: 都市・文字・国のしくみが発達した社会。授業では 4대 문명은 큰 강가에서 시작되었어요.(四大文明は大きな川のほとりで始まった)
column2: A society with cities, writing and government. In class: 4대 문명은 큰 강가에서 시작되었어요. (Four great civilizations began along big rivers.)

column1: 帝国
column2: empire

column1: 皇帝などが広い地域や多くの民族を支配する国。授業では 로마 제국은 수백 년 동안 이어졌어요.(ローマ帝国は何百年も続いた)
column2: A state where one ruler governs many lands and peoples. In class: 로마 제국은 수백 년 동안 이어졌어요. (The Roman Empire lasted for hundreds of years.)

column1: 社会 1
column2: Social studies 1

column1: 植民地
column2: colony

column1: ほかの国に支配された土地。授業では 인도는 한때 영국의 식민지였어요.(インドはかつてイギリスの植民地だった)
column2: A land ruled by another country. In class: 인도는 한때 영국의 식민지였어요. (India was once a British colony.)

column1: 独立
column2: independence

column1: ほかの国の支配から離れて自分の国になること。授業では 미국은 1776년에 독립을 선언했어요.(アメリカは1776年に独立を宣言した)
column2: Becoming a country free from another country's rule. In class: 미국은 1776년에 독립을 선언했어요. (The United States declared independence in 1776.)

column1: 条約
column2: treaty

column1: 国と国が文書で結ぶ約束。授業では 두 나라는 평화 조약에 서명했어요.(2つの国は平和条約に署名した)
column2: A written agreement between countries. In class: 두 나라는 평화 조약에 서명했어요. (The two countries signed a peace treaty.)

column1: 民主主義
column2: democracy

column1: 国民が選挙などを通して政治を決めるしくみ。授業では 민주주의에서는 국민이 지도자를 뽑아요.(民主主義では、国民がリーダーを選ぶ)
column2: Government chosen by the people. In class: 민주주의에서는 국민이 지도자를 뽑아요. (In a democracy, people choose their leaders.)

column1: 首相(総理大臣)
column2: prime minister

column1: 議会で選ばれる政府のリーダー。授業では 총리는 내각을 이끌어요.(首相は内閣を率いる)
column2: The leader of the government chosen by parliament. In class: 총리는 내각을 이끌어요. (The prime minister leads the cabinet.)

column1: 人権
column2: human rights

column1: 人が生まれながらにもつ権利。授業では 모든 사람의 인권은 존중되어야 해요.(すべての人の人権が尊重されなければならない)
column2: The rights every person is born with. In class: 모든 사람의 인권은 존중되어야 해요. (Everyone's human rights must be respected.)

column1: 税金
column2: tax

column1: 国や自治体の仕事のために国民が納めるお金。授業では 세금으로 도로와 학교를 만들어요.(税金で道路や学校がまかなわれている)
column2: Money people pay for public services. In class: 세금으로 도로와 학교를 만들어요. (Taxes pay for roads and schools.)

column1: 貿易
column2: trade

column1: 国と国の間でものを売り買いすること。授業では 일본과 중국의 무역은 아주 활발해요.(日本と中国の貿易はとてもさかんだ)
column2: Buying and selling between countries. In class: 일본과 중국의 무역은 아주 활발해요. (Trade between Japan and China is very active.)

column1: 社会 2
column2: Social studies 2

column1: 代名詞
column2: pronoun

column1: 名詞の代わりに使う語(「彼」「それ」など)。授業では 명사를 대명사로 바꿔 봅시다.(名詞を代名詞に置き換えよう)
column2: A word used instead of a noun. In class: 명사를 대명사로 바꿔 봅시다. (Replace the noun with a pronoun.)

column1: 接続詞
column2: conjunction

column1: 語や文をつなぐ語(「そして」「しかし」など)。授業では 접속사로 두 문장을 이어 봅시다.(接続詞で2つの文をつなごう)
column2: A word that joins words or sentences. In class: 접속사로 두 문장을 이어 봅시다. (Join the two sentences with a conjunction.)

column1: 句読点(記号)
column2: punctuation

column1: ピリオド・コンマ・クエスチョンマークなどの記号。授業では 문장 끝에 문장 부호를 잊지 마세요.(それぞれの文の終わりの句読点を忘れないで)
column2: Marks such as periods, commas and question marks. In class: 문장 끝에 문장 부호를 잊지 마세요. (Don't forget the punctuation at the end of each sentence.)

column1: 類義語(同じ意味の語)
column2: synonym

column1: 意味が同じか近い語。授業では 이 단어의 유의어를 찾아봅시다.(この単語の類義語を見つけよう)
column2: A word with the same or a similar meaning. In class: 이 단어의 유의어를 찾아봅시다. (Find a synonym for this word.)

column1: 要旨(いちばん言いたいこと)
column2: main idea

column1: 文章全体で筆者が伝えたいこと。授業では 이 문단의 중심 내용은 무엇일까요?(この段落の要旨は何かな?)
column2: What the writer most wants to say. In class: 이 문단의 중심 내용은 무엇일까요? (What is the main idea of this paragraph?)

column1: 要約する
column2: summarize

column1: 大事なところだけを短くまとめる。授業では 그 장을 세 문장으로 요약해 봅시다.(その章を3文で要約しよう)
column2: To say only the important parts in short. In class: 그 장을 세 문장으로 요약해 봅시다. (Summarize the chapter in three sentences.)

column1: あらすじ(筋)
column2: plot (of a story)

column1: 物語のできごとの流れ。授業では 이 소설의 줄거리는 놀라움으로 가득해요.(この小説の筋は驚きでいっぱいだ)
column2: The order of events in a story. In class: 이 소설의 줄거리는 놀라움으로 가득해요. (The plot of this novel is full of surprises.)

column1: 登場人物
column2: character

column1: 物語に出てくる人や動物。授業では 이야기의 주인공은 누구일까요?(物語の主人公はだれかな?)
column2: A person or animal in a story. In class: 이야기의 주인공은 누구일까요? (Who is the main character in the story?)

column1: 国語 1
column2: Language arts 1

column1: テーマ(主題)
column2: theme

column1: 物語を通して伝わる大切な考え。授業では 이 이야기의 주제는 우정이에요.(物語のテーマは友情だ)
column2: The important idea a story shows. In class: 이 이야기의 주제는 우정이에요. (The theme of the story is friendship.)

column1: 語り手
column2: narrator

column1: 物語を語っている人。授業では 서술자가 1인칭으로 이야기를 들려줘요.(語り手は一人称で物語を語っている)
column2: The one who tells the story. In class: 서술자가 1인칭으로 이야기를 들려줘요. (The narrator tells the story in the first person.)

column1: 隠喩(メタファー)
column2: metaphor

column1: 「〜のようだ」を使わずに、何かを別のものにたとえる表現。授業では '인생은 여행이다'는 은유예요.(「人生は旅だ」は隠喩だ)
column2: Saying one thing is another thing, without "like". In class: '인생은 여행이다'는 은유예요. ("Life is a journey" is a metaphor.)

column1: 結論
column2: conclusion

column1: エッセイの最後でまとめる部分。授業では 결론에서 주요 주장을 다시 말해 봅시다.(結論でもう一度主な主張を述べよう)
column2: The part that sums up an essay. In class: 결론에서 주요 주장을 다시 말해 봅시다. (Restate your main point in the conclusion.)

column1: 下書き
column2: rough draft

column1: まず全体を書いてみたもの。授業では 금요일까지 초고를 끝내세요.(金曜日までに下書きを終わらせよう)
column2: The first full version of a piece of writing. In class: 금요일까지 초고를 끝내세요. (Finish your rough draft by Friday.)

column1: 校正する
column2: proofread

column1: つづりや句読点のまちがいを確かめる。授業では 맞춤법 실수가 없는지 꼼꼼히 교정하세요.(つづりのまちがいがないか注意して校正しよう)
column2: To check for spelling and punctuation mistakes. In class: 맞춤법 실수가 없는지 꼼꼼히 교정하세요. (Proofread carefully for spelling mistakes.)

column1: 発表(プレゼン)
column2: presentation

column1: 人の前で調べたことや考えを伝えること。授業では 모둠마다 5분 동안 발표해요.(各グループが5分の発表をする)
column2: Telling people what you found in front of them. In class: 모둠마다 5분 동안 발표해요. (Each group will give a five-minute presentation.)

column1: ディベート(討論)
column2: debate

column1: 決められたテーマについて、賛成と反対に分かれて議論すること。授業では 오늘의 토론 주제는 교복이에요.(今日のディベートのテーマは制服だ)
column2: Arguing for and against a topic. In class: 오늘의 토론 주제는 교복이에요. (Today's debate topic is school uniforms.)

column1: 国語 2
column2: Language arts 2

column1: ハードウェア
column2: hardware

column2: The machine parts of a computer. In class: 키보드와 화면은 하드웨어예요. (The keyboard and the screen are hardware.)

column1: ソフトウェア
column2: software

column2: The programs that run a computer. In class: 수업 전에 소프트웨어를 설치해 두세요. (Install the software before class.)

column1: OS(オペレーティングシステム)
column2: operating system

column2: The basic software that runs the whole computer. In class: Windows와 macOS는 운영 체제예요. (Windows and macOS are operating systems.)

column2: binary

column2: Writing numbers with only 0 and 1. In class: 컴퓨터는 모든 것을 이진법으로 저장해요. (Computers store everything in binary.)

column1: 画素(ピクセル)
column2: pixel

column2: A tiny dot that makes up an image. In class: 확대하면 화소 하나하나가 보여요. (Zoom in and you can see each pixel.)

column1: アルゴリズム
column2: algorithm

column2: A list of steps to solve a problem. In class: 샌드위치를 만드는 알고리즘을 써 봅시다. (Write an algorithm for making a sandwich.)

column2: flowchart

column2: A diagram of steps with shapes and arrows. In class: 코드를 쓰기 전에 순서도를 그려 봅시다. (Draw a flowchart before you code.)

column2: loop

column2: Doing the same instructions again and again. In class: 반복문을 써서 별 10개를 그려 봅시다. (Use a loop to draw ten stars.)

column2: Computing 1

column2: debug

column2: To find and fix mistakes in a program. In class: 이 코드를 함께 디버깅해 봅시다. (Let's debug this code together.)

column2: network

column2: Computers connected together. In class: 이 교실의 컴퓨터는 모두 같은 네트워크에 연결되어 있어요. (All the computers in this room are on the same network.)

column1: 検索エンジン
column2: search engine

column2: A service that finds web pages by keywords. In class: 검색 엔진에서는 좋은 키워드를 쓰세요. (Use good keywords in the search engine.)

column2: phishing

column2: Tricking people into giving their information with fake messages. In class: 피싱 메일의 링크는 절대 누르지 마세요. (Never click links in phishing emails.)

column1: 暗号化
column2: encryption

column2: Changing data so only the right people can read it. In class: 암호화로 메시지의 비밀이 지켜져요. (Encryption keeps your messages private.)

column2: personal information

column2: Information that shows who you are, like your address. In class: 인터넷에 개인 정보를 올리지 마세요. (Don't share personal information online.)

column2: copyright

column2: artificial intelligence

column2: Computers that learn and decide like people. In class: 인공지능은 언어를 번역할 수 있어요. (Artificial intelligence can translate languages.)

column2: The tissue that moves the body. In class: 달리기 전에 다리 근육을 늘려 주세요. (Stretch your leg muscles before running.)

column2: bone

column2: The hard part that holds up the body. In class: 칼슘은 뼈를 튼튼하게 해요. (Calcium makes your bones strong.)

column2: joint

column2: How many times the heart beats in a minute. In class: 달린 뒤에 심박수를 재 보세요. (Check your heart rate after the run.)

column2: nutrient

column2: Meals with the right mix of nutrients. In class: 균형 잡힌 식사에는 과일, 채소, 곡물이 들어가요. (A balanced diet includes fruit, vegetables and grains.)

column2: Drinking the water your body needs. In class: 더운 날에는 수분 보충이 중요해요. (Hydration is important on hot days.)

column1: 心の健康
column2: mental health

column2: The health of your mind and feelings. In class: 친구와 이야기하면 정신 건강에 도움이 돼요. (Talking to a friend can help your mental health.)

column2: Help given on the spot to someone hurt or ill. In class: 누구나 기본적인 응급 처치를 배워야 해요. (Everyone should learn basic first aid.)

column2: An injury from twisting a joint. In class: 그는 발목에 염좌가 생겼어요. (He has a sprain in his ankle.)

column2: heatstroke

column2: Getting sick when the body gets too hot. In class: 열사병을 막으려면 그늘에서 쉬세요. (Take breaks in the shade to avoid heatstroke.)

column2: P.E. and health 2

column2: The five lines that music is written on. In class: 오선에 음표를 그려 보세요. (Write the notes on the staff.)

column2: A note one beat long. In class: 4분음표는 1박이에요. (A quarter note gets one beat.)

column2: The sign that shows how many beats are in a measure. In class: 이 노래는 4분의 3박자예요. (This song has a three-four time signature.)

column2: The steady pulse of music. In class: 박마다 손뼉을 치세요. (Clap on every beat.)

column2: tempo

column2: How fast the music goes. In class: 처음에는 빠르기가 느려요. (The tempo is slow at the beginning.)

column2: scale

column2: string instrument

column1: 打楽器
column2: percussion instrument

column2: An instrument played by hitting or shaking. In class: 드럼은 타악기예요. (Drums are percussion instruments.)

column2: The person who leads the orchestra or choir. In class: 빠르기는 지휘자를 보고 맞추세요. (Watch the conductor for the tempo.)

column2: The words of a song. In class: 가사를 다 외웠나요? (Do you know the lyrics by heart?)

column1: 遠近法
column2: perspective

column1: 近くを大きく遠くを小さく描いて奥行きを出す方法。授業では 원근법으로 길이 길어 보이게 해 보세요.(遠近法を使って道が長く見えるようにしよう)
column2: Drawing near things big and far things small to show depth. In class: 원근법으로 길이 길어 보이게 해 보세요. (Use perspective to make the road look long.)

column1: 静物画
column2: still life

column1: 果物や花びんなど、動かないものを描いた絵。授業では 오늘은 과일 정물화를 그려요.(今日は果物の静物画を描く)
column2: A picture of objects that don't move. In class: 오늘은 과일 정물화를 그려요. (Today we'll paint a still life of fruit.)

column1: 肖像画
column2: portrait

column1: 人の顔や姿を描いた絵。授業では 옆 사람의 초상화를 그려 보세요.(隣の人の肖像画を描こう)
column2: A picture of a person. In class: 옆 사람의 초상화를 그려 보세요. (Draw a portrait of the person next to you.)

column1: 三原色(絵の具)
column2: primary colors

column1: まぜて多くの色を作れるもとの3色(赤・青・黄)。授業では 빨강, 파랑, 노랑이 삼원색이에요.(赤・青・黄が三原色だ)
column2: The three colors you mix others from (red, blue, yellow). In class: 빨강, 파랑, 노랑이 삼원색이에요. (Red, blue and yellow are the primary colors.)

column1: 補色
column2: complementary colors

column1: 色相環で向かい合う、たがいを引き立てる色。授業では 주황과 파랑은 보색이에요.(オレンジと青は補色だ)
column2: Colors opposite each other on the color wheel. In class: 주황과 파랑은 보색이에요. (Orange and blue are complementary colors.)

column1: 構図
column2: composition

column1: 画面の中での配置。授業では 그리기 전에 구도를 생각해 보세요.(描く前に構図を考えよう)
column2: How things are arranged in a picture. In class: 그리기 전에 구도를 생각해 보세요. (Think about the composition before you paint.)

column1: 美術 1
column2: Art 1

column1: 背景
column2: background

column1: 絵の奥の部分。授業では 배경을 먼저 칠하세요.(背景を先に塗ろう)
column2: The back part of a picture. In class: 배경을 먼저 칠하세요. (Paint the background first.)

column1: 水彩絵の具
column2: watercolor

column1: 水でといて使う、すき通る絵の具。授業では 수채 물감은 금방 마르니까 빨리 그리세요.(水彩絵の具はすぐ乾くので手早く描こう)
column2: Clear paint you mix with water. In class: 수채 물감은 금방 마르니까 빨리 그리세요. (Watercolor dries quickly, so work fast.)

column1: パレット
column2: palette

column1: 絵の具をまぜる板。授業では 색은 종이가 아니라 팔레트에서 섞으세요.(色は紙の上ではなくパレットでまぜよう)
column2: The board you mix paint on. In class: 색은 종이가 아니라 팔레트에서 섞으세요. (Mix the colors on your palette, not on the paper.)

column1: 粘土
column2: clay

column1: 形を自由に作れるやわらかい土。授業では 찰흙으로 작은 그릇을 만들어 보세요.(粘土で小さなお皿の形を作ろう)
column2: Soft earth you can shape. In class: 찰흙으로 작은 그릇을 만들어 보세요. (Shape the clay into a small bowl.)

column1: 彫刻
column2: sculpture

column1: 立体的に作った作品。授業では 이 조각은 돌로 만들어졌어요.(この彫刻は石でできている)
column2: A work of art made in 3D. In class: 이 조각은 돌로 만들어졌어요. (This sculpture is made of stone.)

column1: 版画
column2: printmaking

column1: 版を作ってインクで紙に写す方法。授業では 판화는 그림 하나로 여러 장을 찍을 수 있어요.(版画では1つの絵からたくさん刷ることができる)
column2: Making pictures by printing from a block. In class: 판화는 그림 하나로 여러 장을 찍을 수 있어요. (In printmaking, you can make many copies of one picture.)

column1: 傑作(名作)
column2: masterpiece

column1: とてもすぐれた作品。授業では 모나리자는 유명한 걸작이에요.(モナ・リザは有名な傑作だ)
column2: A very great work of art. In class: 모나리자는 유명한 걸작이에요. (The Mona Lisa is a famous masterpiece.)

column1: 展覧会
column2: exhibition

column1: 作品を並べて見せる催し。授業では 우리 작품이 학교 전시회에 나가요.(私たちの作品は学校の展覧会に出る)
column2: An event where works are shown. In class: 우리 작품이 학교 전시회에 나가요. (Our artwork will be in the school exhibition.)

column1: 美術 2
column2: Art 2

column1: 0より大きい数。授業では Los números positivos son mayores que cero.(正の数は0より大きい)
column2: A number greater than zero. In class: Los números positivos son mayores que cero. (Positive numbers are greater than zero.)

column1: 0より小さい数。授業では Menos cinco es un número negativo.(-5は負の数です)
column2: A number less than zero. In class: Menos cinco es un número negativo. (Minus five is a negative number.)

column1: …,-1, 0, 1, 2,… のような数。授業では ¿Es cero coma cinco un número entero?(0.5は整数かな?)
column2: A whole number such as -1, 0 or 2. In class: ¿Es cero coma cinco un número entero? (Is zero point five an integer?)

column1: 分数の下の数。授業では Busca el denominador común.(分母をそろえよう=通分)
column2: The number below the line in a fraction. In class: Busca el denominador común. (Find the common denominator.)

column1: 0.5 のような数。授業では Escribe un cuarto como número decimal.(1/4を小数で書こう)
column2: A number like 0.5. In class: Escribe un cuarto como número decimal. (Write one quarter as a decimal.)

column1: 2乗するとその数になる数。授業では La raíz cuadrada de nueve es tres.(9の平方根は3)
column2: The number that, multiplied by itself, gives the number. In class: La raíz cuadrada de nueve es tres. (The square root of nine is three.)

column1: x や y のように、いろいろな値をとる文字。授業では Aquí, x es una variable.(ここでは x が変数)
column2: A letter that stands for a number. In class: Aquí, x es una variable. (Here, x is a variable.)

column1: 2本の線が作る開き。授業では Mide el ángulo con el transportador.(分度器で角をはかろう)
column2: The space between two lines that meet. In class: Mide el ángulo con el transportador. (Measure the angle with a protractor.)

column1: どこまでのばしても交わらないこと。授業では Estas dos rectas son paralelas.(この2本の線は平行)
column2: Never meeting, like the two rails of a track. In class: Estas dos rectas son paralelas. (These two lines are parallel.)

column1: 広さ。授業では Calcula el área del rectángulo.(長方形の面積を求めよう)
column2: The size of a flat surface. In class: Calcula el área del rectángulo. (Find the area of the rectangle.)

column1: 円の中心から円周までの長さ。授業では El radio es la mitad del diámetro.(半径は直径の半分)
column2: The distance from the center of a circle to its edge. In class: El radio es la mitad del diámetro. (The radius is half of the diameter.)

column1: 立体の大きさ。授業では Calcula el volumen del cubo.(立方体の体積を求めよう)
column2: The amount of space inside a solid. In class: Calcula el volumen del cubo. (Find the volume of the cube.)

column1: xが決まるとyがただ1つ決まる関係。授業では y es función de x.(yはxの関数)
column2: A rule where each x gives one y. In class: y es función de x. (y is a function of x.)

column1: 点の位置を表す数の組。授業では Escribe las coordenadas del punto P.(点Pの座標を書こう)
column2: The pair of numbers that shows where a point is. In class: Escribe las coordenadas del punto P. (Write the coordinates of point P.)

column1: あることが起こる割合。授業では ¿Cuál es la probabilidad de que salga cara?(表が出る確率は?)
column2: How likely something is to happen. In class: ¿Cuál es la probabilidad de que salga cara? (What is the probability of getting heads?)

column1: 全部たして個数でわった値。授業では Calcula la media de los datos.(データの平均値を計算しよう)
column2: The total divided by the number of values. In class: Calcula la media de los datos. (Calculate the mean of the data.)

column1: 物を押したり引いたりするはたらき。単位は N(ニュートン)。授業では Dibuja una flecha para representar la fuerza.(力を矢印で表そう)
column2: A push or a pull. In class: Dibuja una flecha para representar la fuerza. (Draw an arrow to show the force.)

column1: ふれ合う面で動きをじゃまする力。授業では La fricción frena la caja.(摩擦で箱がおそくなる)
column2: The force that slows things rubbing together. In class: La fricción frena la caja. (Friction slows the box down.)

column1: 距離÷時間。授業では Calcula la velocidad media.(平均の速さを計算しよう)
column2: Distance divided by time. In class: Calcula la velocidad media. (Calculate the average speed.)

column1: 電気の流れ。単位は A(アンペア)。授業では Mide la corriente con el amperímetro.(電流計で電流をはかろう)
column2: The flow of electricity. In class: Mide la corriente con el amperímetro. (Measure the current with an ammeter.)

column1: 電流を流そうとするはたらき。単位は V(ボルト)。授業では Conecta el voltímetro en paralelo.(電圧計は並列につなごう)
column2: The push that moves electric current. In class: Conecta el voltímetro en paralelo. (Connect the voltmeter in parallel.)

column1: 磁石の力がはたらく空間。授業では Usa limaduras de hierro para ver el campo magnético.(鉄粉で磁界のようすを見よう)
column2: The area where a magnet has an effect. In class: Usa limaduras de hierro para ver el campo magnético. (Use iron filings to see the magnetic field.)

column1: 物質をつくるもとになる成分。授業では Busca el elemento en la tabla periódica.(周期表でその元素を探そう)
column2: A substance made of only one kind of atom. In class: Busca el elemento en la tabla periódica. (Find the element on the periodic table.)

column1: 物質をつくる、とても小さなつぶ。授業では Los átomos son demasiado pequeños para verlos.(原子は小さすぎて見えない)
column2: The tiny unit that everything is made of. In class: Los átomos son demasiado pequeños para verlos. (Atoms are too small to see.)

column1: 水溶液が酸性を示す物質。授業では El zumo de limón es un ácido.(レモン汁は酸)
column2: A substance that turns blue litmus paper red. In class: El zumo de limón es un ácido. (Lemon juice is an acid.)

column1: 細胞が栄養分からエネルギーを取り出すはたらき。授業では La respiración libera energía.(呼吸でエネルギーが取り出される)
column2: How living things get energy from food. In class: La respiración libera energía. (Respiration releases energy.)

column1: 食べ物を体に吸収できる形に分解すること。授業では La digestión empieza en la boca.(消化は口から始まる)
column2: Breaking food down so the body can use it. In class: La digestión empieza en la boca. (Digestion starts in the mouth.)

column1: 親から子に伝わる特徴のもと。授業では Los genes pasan de padres a hijos.(遺伝子は親から子に伝わる)
column2: The part of a cell that carries traits from parents. In class: Los genes pasan de padres a hijos. (Genes are passed from parents to children.)

column1: 「食べる・食べられる」のつながり。授業では Dibuja una cadena alimentaria del bosque.(森の食物連鎖をかこう)
column2: The line of who eats whom in nature. In class: Dibuja una cadena alimentaria del bosque. (Draw a food chain for the forest.)

column1: マグマがふき出してできた山。授業では Este volcán todavía está activo.(この火山は今も活動している)
column2: A mountain where magma comes out. In class: Este volcán todavía está activo. (This volcano is still active.)

column1: 大昔の生物の死がいや跡が残ったもの。授業では Los fósiles nos hablan de la vida antigua.(化石から大昔の生物がわかる)
column2: What is left of a living thing from long ago, turned to rock. In class: Los fósiles nos hablan de la vida antigua. (Fossils tell us about ancient life.)

column1: 太陽とそのまわりを回る天体の集まり。授業では Hay ocho planetas en el sistema solar.(太陽系には8つの惑星がある)
column2: The Sun and everything that goes around it. In class: Hay ocho planetas en el sistema solar. (There are eight planets in the solar system.)

column1: 赤道から北や南へどれだけ離れているか。授業では Tokio está a unos 36 grados de latitud norte.(東京は北緯約36度にある)
column2: How far north or south of the equator. In class: Tokio está a unos 36 grados de latitud norte. (Tokyo is at about 36 degrees north latitude.)

column1: 三方を海に囲まれた陸地。授業では Italia es una península larga con forma de bota.(イタリアはブーツの形をした長い半島だ)
column2: Land with the sea on three sides. In class: Italia es una península larga con forma de bota. (Italy is a long peninsula shaped like a boot.)

column1: 一定の面積に何人住んでいるか。授業では Tokio tiene una densidad de población muy alta.(東京は人口密度がとても高い)
column2: How many people live in a given area. In class: Tokio tiene una densidad de población muy alta. (Tokyo has a very high population density.)

column1: 国内のものを外国に売ること。授業では Japón exporta muchos coches.(日本はたくさんの車を輸出している)
column2: To sell goods to other countries. In class: Japón exporta muchos coches. (Japan exports a lot of cars.)

column1: 外国のものを国内に買い入れること。授業では La mayor parte del trigo de Japón es importado.(日本の小麦のほとんどは輸入されている)
column2: To buy goods from other countries. In class: La mayor parte del trigo de Japón es importado. (Most of the wheat in Japan is imported.)

column1: 作物を育てたり家畜を飼ったりする仕事。授業では La agricultura es importante en esta región.(この地域では農業が大切だ)
column2: Growing crops and raising animals. In class: La agricultura es importante en esta región. (Agriculture is important in this region.)

column1: 都市・文字・国のしくみが発達した社会。授業では Las cuatro grandes civilizaciones nacieron junto a grandes ríos.(四大文明は大きな川のほとりで始まった)
column2: A society with cities, writing and government. In class: Las cuatro grandes civilizaciones nacieron junto a grandes ríos. (Four great civilizations began along big rivers.)

column1: 皇帝などが広い地域や多くの民族を支配する国。授業では El Imperio romano duró cientos de años.(ローマ帝国は何百年も続いた)
column2: A state where one ruler governs many lands and peoples. In class: El Imperio romano duró cientos de años. (The Roman Empire lasted for hundreds of years.)

column1: ほかの国に支配された土地。授業では La India fue una colonia británica.(インドはかつてイギリスの植民地だった)
column2: A land ruled by another country. In class: La India fue una colonia británica. (India was once a British colony.)

column1: ほかの国の支配から離れて自分の国になること。授業では Estados Unidos declaró su independencia en 1776.(アメリカは1776年に独立を宣言した)
column2: Becoming a country free from another country's rule. In class: Estados Unidos declaró su independencia en 1776. (The United States declared independence in 1776.)

column1: 国と国が文書で結ぶ約束。授業では Los dos países firmaron un tratado de paz.(2つの国は平和条約に署名した)
column2: A written agreement between countries. In class: Los dos países firmaron un tratado de paz. (The two countries signed a peace treaty.)

column1: 国民が選挙などを通して政治を決めるしくみ。授業では En una democracia, el pueblo elige a sus líderes.(民主主義では、国民がリーダーを選ぶ)
column2: Government chosen by the people. In class: En una democracia, el pueblo elige a sus líderes. (In a democracy, people choose their leaders.)

column1: 議会で選ばれる政府のリーダー。授業では El primer ministro dirige el gabinete.(首相は内閣を率いる)
column2: The leader of the government chosen by parliament. In class: El primer ministro dirige el gabinete. (The prime minister leads the cabinet.)

column1: 人が生まれながらにもつ権利。授業では Hay que respetar los derechos humanos de todos.(すべての人の人権が尊重されなければならない)
column2: The rights every person is born with. In class: Hay que respetar los derechos humanos de todos. (Everyone's human rights must be respected.)

column1: 国や自治体の仕事のために国民が納めるお金。授業では Los impuestos pagan las carreteras y las escuelas.(税金で道路や学校がまかなわれている)
column2: Money people pay for public services. In class: Los impuestos pagan las carreteras y las escuelas. (Taxes pay for roads and schools.)

column1: 国と国の間でものを売り買いすること。授業では El comercio entre Japón y China es muy activo.(日本と中国の貿易はとてもさかんだ)
column2: Buying and selling between countries. In class: El comercio entre Japón y China es muy activo. (Trade between Japan and China is very active.)

column1: 名詞の代わりに使う語(「彼」「それ」など)。授業では Cambia el sustantivo por un pronombre.(名詞を代名詞に置き換えよう)
column2: A word used instead of a noun. In class: Cambia el sustantivo por un pronombre. (Replace the noun with a pronoun.)

column1: 語や文をつなぐ語(「そして」「しかし」など)。授業では Une las dos oraciones con una conjunción.(接続詞で2つの文をつなごう)
column2: A word that joins words or sentences. In class: Une las dos oraciones con una conjunción. (Join the two sentences with a conjunction.)

column1: ピリオド・コンマ・クエスチョンマークなどの記号。授業では No olvides la puntuación al final de cada oración.(それぞれの文の終わりの句読点を忘れないで)
column2: Marks such as periods, commas and question marks. In class: No olvides la puntuación al final de cada oración. (Don't forget the punctuation at the end of each sentence.)

column1: 意味が同じか近い語。授業では Busca un sinónimo de esta palabra.(この単語の類義語を見つけよう)
column2: A word with the same or a similar meaning. In class: Busca un sinónimo de esta palabra. (Find a synonym for this word.)

column1: 文章全体で筆者が伝えたいこと。授業では ¿Cuál es la idea principal de este párrafo?(この段落の要旨は何かな?)
column2: What the writer most wants to say. In class: ¿Cuál es la idea principal de este párrafo? (What is the main idea of this paragraph?)

column1: 大事なところだけを短くまとめる。授業では Resume el capítulo en tres oraciones.(その章を3文で要約しよう)
column2: To say only the important parts in short. In class: Resume el capítulo en tres oraciones. (Summarize the chapter in three sentences.)

column1: 物語のできごとの流れ。授業では El argumento de esta novela está lleno de sorpresas.(この小説の筋は驚きでいっぱいだ)
column2: The order of events in a story. In class: El argumento de esta novela está lleno de sorpresas. (The plot of this novel is full of surprises.)

column1: 物語に出てくる人や動物。授業では ¿Quién es el personaje principal de la historia?(物語の主人公はだれかな?)
column2: A person or animal in a story. In class: ¿Quién es el personaje principal de la historia? (Who is the main character in the story?)

column1: 物語を通して伝わる大切な考え。授業では El tema de la historia es la amistad.(物語のテーマは友情だ)
column2: The important idea a story shows. In class: El tema de la historia es la amistad. (The theme of the story is friendship.)

column1: 物語を語っている人。授業では El narrador cuenta la historia en primera persona.(語り手は一人称で物語を語っている)
column2: The one who tells the story. In class: El narrador cuenta la historia en primera persona. (The narrator tells the story in the first person.)

column1: 「〜のようだ」を使わずに、何かを別のものにたとえる表現。授業では «La vida es un viaje» es una metáfora.(「人生は旅だ」は隠喩だ)
column2: Saying one thing is another thing, without "like". In class: «La vida es un viaje» es una metáfora. ("Life is a journey" is a metaphor.)

column1: エッセイの最後でまとめる部分。授業では Repite tu idea principal en la conclusión.(結論でもう一度主な主張を述べよう)
column2: The part that sums up an essay. In class: Repite tu idea principal en la conclusión. (Restate your main point in the conclusion.)

column1: まず全体を書いてみたもの。授業では Termina el borrador antes del viernes.(金曜日までに下書きを終わらせよう)
column2: The first full version of a piece of writing. In class: Termina el borrador antes del viernes. (Finish your rough draft by Friday.)

column1: つづりや句読点のまちがいを確かめる。授業では Revisa bien las faltas de ortografía.(つづりのまちがいがないか注意して校正しよう)
column2: To check for spelling and punctuation mistakes. In class: Revisa bien las faltas de ortografía. (Proofread carefully for spelling mistakes.)

column1: 人の前で調べたことや考えを伝えること。授業では Cada grupo hará una presentación de cinco minutos.(各グループが5分の発表をする)
column2: Telling people what you found in front of them. In class: Cada grupo hará una presentación de cinco minutos. (Each group will give a five-minute presentation.)

column1: 決められたテーマについて、賛成と反対に分かれて議論すること。授業では El tema del debate de hoy es el uniforme escolar.(今日のディベートのテーマは制服だ)
column2: Arguing for and against a topic. In class: El tema del debate de hoy es el uniforme escolar. (Today's debate topic is school uniforms.)

column1: コンピューターの機械の部分。授業では El teclado y la pantalla son hardware.(キーボードと画面はハードウェアだ)
column2: The machine parts of a computer. In class: El teclado y la pantalla son hardware. (The keyboard and the screen are hardware.)

column1: コンピューターを動かすプログラム。授業では Instala el software antes de la clase.(授業の前にソフトウェアをインストールしておこう)
column2: The programs that run a computer. In class: Instala el software antes de la clase. (Install the software before class.)

column1: コンピューター全体を管理する基本のソフト。授業では Windows y macOS son sistemas operativos.(Windows と macOS はOSだ)
column2: The basic software that runs the whole computer. In class: Windows y macOS son sistemas operativos. (Windows and macOS are operating systems.)

column1: 0と1だけで数を表す方法。授業では Los ordenadores guardan todo en binario.(コンピューターはすべてを2進法で記録する)
column2: Writing numbers with only 0 and 1. In class: Los ordenadores guardan todo en binario. (Computers store everything in binary.)

column1: 画像をつくる小さな点。授業では Si haces zoom, puedes ver cada píxel.(拡大すると一つ一つの画素が見える)
column2: A tiny dot that makes up an image. In class: Si haces zoom, puedes ver cada píxel. (Zoom in and you can see each pixel.)

column1: 問題を解くための手順。授業では Escribe un algoritmo para hacer un sándwich.(サンドイッチを作るアルゴリズムを書こう)
column2: A list of steps to solve a problem. In class: Escribe un algoritmo para hacer un sándwich. (Write an algorithm for making a sandwich.)

column1: 手順を図形と矢印で表した図。授業では Dibuja un diagrama de flujo antes de programar.(コードを書く前にフローチャートを描こう)
column2: A diagram of steps with shapes and arrows. In class: Dibuja un diagrama de flujo antes de programar. (Draw a flowchart before you code.)

column1: 同じ命令を何回もくり返すこと。授業では Usa un bucle para dibujar diez estrellas.(繰り返しを使って星を10個描こう)
column2: Doing the same instructions again and again. In class: Usa un bucle para dibujar diez estrellas. (Use a loop to draw ten stars.)

column1: プログラムのまちがい(バグ)を見つけて直す。授業では Vamos a depurar este código juntos.(このコードを一緒にデバッグしよう)
column2: To find and fix mistakes in a program. In class: Vamos a depurar este código juntos. (Let's debug this code together.)

column1: コンピューターどうしをつないだもの。授業では Todos los ordenadores de esta aula están en la misma red.(この部屋のコンピューターはみんな同じネットワークにつながっている)
column2: Computers connected together. In class: Todos los ordenadores de esta aula están en la misma red. (All the computers in this room are on the same network.)

column1: キーワードでウェブの情報を探すサービス。授業では Usa buenas palabras clave en el buscador.(検索エンジンではよいキーワードを使おう)
column2: A service that finds web pages by keywords. In class: Usa buenas palabras clave en el buscador. (Use good keywords in the search engine.)

column1: 本物そっくりのメールやサイトで個人情報をだましとる手口。授業では Nunca hagas clic en los enlaces de correos de phishing.(フィッシングメールのリンクは絶対にクリックしないで)
column2: Tricking people into giving their information with fake messages. In class: Nunca hagas clic en los enlaces de correos de phishing. (Never click links in phishing emails.)

column1: データを決まった人しか読めない形に変えること。授業では El cifrado protege la privacidad de tus mensajes.(暗号化によってメッセージの秘密が守られる)
column2: Changing data so only the right people can read it. In class: El cifrado protege la privacidad de tus mensajes. (Encryption keeps your messages private.)

column1: 名前・住所・電話番号など、その人がわかる情報。授業では No compartas datos personales en internet.(ネットで個人情報を公開しないで)
column2: Information that shows who you are, like your address. In class: No compartas datos personales en internet. (Don't share personal information online.)

column1: 作品を作った人がもつ権利。授業では Esta canción está protegida por derechos de autor.(この曲は著作権で守られている)
column2: The right of the person who made a work. In class: Esta canción está protegida por derechos de autor. (This song is protected by copyright.)

column1: 人のように学んだり判断したりするコンピューターの技術。授業では La inteligencia artificial puede traducir idiomas.(人工知能は言葉を翻訳できる)
column2: Computers that learn and decide like people. In class: La inteligencia artificial puede traducir idiomas. (Artificial intelligence can translate languages.)

column1: 体を動かすために縮んだりゆるんだりする組織。授業では Estira los músculos de las piernas antes de correr.(走る前に脚の筋肉を伸ばそう)
column2: The tissue that moves the body. In class: Estira los músculos de las piernas antes de correr. (Stretch your leg muscles before running.)

column1: 体を支え、内臓を守るかたいもの。授業では El calcio fortalece los huesos.(カルシウムは骨を強くする)
column2: The hard part that holds up the body. In class: El calcio fortalece los huesos. (Calcium makes your bones strong.)

column1: 骨と骨のつなぎ目。授業では La rodilla es una articulación.(ひざは関節だ)
column2: Where two bones meet. In class: La rodilla es una articulación. (Your knee is a joint.)

column1: 1分間に心臓が打つ回数。授業では Mide tu frecuencia cardíaca después de correr.(走ったあとに心拍数を測ろう)
column2: How many times the heart beats in a minute. In class: Mide tu frecuencia cardíaca después de correr. (Check your heart rate after the run.)

column1: 子どもから大人の体に変わっていく時期。授業では Tu cuerpo cambia mucho durante la pubertad.(思春期には体が大きく変わる)
column2: The time when a child's body becomes an adult's. In class: Tu cuerpo cambia mucho durante la pubertad. (Your body changes a lot during puberty.)

column1: 体に必要な、食べ物にふくまれる成分。授業では Las verduras están llenas de nutrientes.(野菜には栄養素がたくさんふくまれている)
column2: What in food the body needs. In class: Las verduras están llenas de nutrientes. (Vegetables are full of nutrients.)

column1: 筋肉や血をつくる栄養素。授業では Come proteínas para ganar músculo.(筋肉をつけるにはたんぱく質をとろう)
column2: A nutrient that builds muscle. In class: Come proteínas para ganar músculo. (Eat protein to build muscle.)

column1: いろいろな栄養素をほどよくとる食事。授業では Una dieta equilibrada incluye fruta, verdura y cereales.(バランスのよい食事には果物・野菜・穀物が入る)
column2: Meals with the right mix of nutrients. In class: Una dieta equilibrada incluye fruta, verdura y cereales. (A balanced diet includes fruit, vegetables and grains.)

column1: 体に必要な水分をとること。授業では La hidratación es importante en los días de calor.(暑い日は水分補給が大切だ)
column2: Drinking the water your body needs. In class: La hidratación es importante en los días de calor. (Hydration is important on hot days.)

column1: 気持ちや心の状態の健康。授業では Hablar con un amigo puede ayudar a tu salud mental.(友だちに話すことは心の健康の助けになる)
column2: The health of your mind and feelings. In class: Hablar con un amigo puede ayudar a tu salud mental. (Talking to a friend can help your mental health.)

column1: けがや急な病気のときにその場でする手当て。授業では Todos deberían aprender primeros auxilios básicos.(だれもが基本の応急手当を学ぶべきだ)
column2: Help given on the spot to someone hurt or ill. In class: Todos deberían aprender primeros auxilios básicos. (Everyone should learn basic first aid.)

column1: 関節をひねって痛めること。授業では Tiene un esguince en el tobillo.(彼は足首をねんざしている)
column2: An injury from twisting a joint. In class: Tiene un esguince en el tobillo. (He has a sprain in his ankle.)

column1: 暑さで体温が上がりすぎて具合が悪くなること。授業では Descansa a la sombra para evitar un golpe de calor.(熱中症を防ぐために日かげで休もう)
column2: Getting sick when the body gets too hot. In class: Descansa a la sombra para evitar un golpe de calor. (Take breaks in the shade to avoid heatstroke.)

column1: 試合のルールを守らせる人。授業では Escucha el silbato del árbitro.(審判の笛をよく聞こう)
column2: The person who makes players follow the rules. In class: Escucha el silbato del árbitro. (Listen to the referee's whistle.)

column1: ルールに違反すること。授業では Empujar es falta.(押すのは反則だ)
column2: Breaking a rule in a game. In class: Empujar es falta. (Pushing is a foul.)

column1: チームで順番に走ってバトンをつなぐ競走。授業では Pasa bien el testigo en la carrera de relevos.(リレーではバトンをなめらかに渡そう)
column2: A race where team members run in turn. In class: Pasa bien el testigo en la carrera de relevos. (Pass the baton smoothly in the relay.)

column1: 音符を書く5本の線。授業では Escribe las notas en el pentagrama.(五線に音符を書こう)
column2: The five lines that music is written on. In class: Escribe las notas en el pentagrama. (Write the notes on the staff.)

column1: 1拍分の長さの音符。授業では Una negra dura un tiempo.(四分音符は1拍だ)
column2: A note one beat long. In class: Una negra dura un tiempo. (A quarter note gets one beat.)

column1: 1小節に何拍あるかを表す記号。授業では Esta canción está en compás de tres por cuatro.(この曲は4分の3拍子だ)
column2: The sign that shows how many beats are in a measure. In class: Esta canción está en compás de tres por cuatro. (This song has a three-four time signature.)

column1: 音楽の一定の刻み。授業では Da una palmada en cada pulso.(毎拍、手をたたこう)
column2: The steady pulse of music. In class: Da una palmada en cada pulso. (Clap on every beat.)

column1: 曲の速さ。授業では Al principio, el tempo es lento.(最初はテンポがゆっくりだ)
column2: How fast the music goes. In class: Al principio, el tempo es lento. (The tempo is slow at the beginning.)

column1: ドレミファソラシドのように順に並んだ音。授業では Toca la escala de do mayor.(ハ長調の音階を弾こう)
column2: Notes in order, like do re mi. In class: Toca la escala de do mayor. (Play the C major scale.)

column1: 明るい感じの調。授業では Esta canción está en tonalidad mayor, por eso suena alegre.(この曲は長調なので明るく聞こえる)
column2: A key that sounds bright. In class: Esta canción está en tonalidad mayor, por eso suena alegre. (This song is in a major key, so it sounds happy.)

column1: 暗い・悲しい感じの調。授業では Las tonalidades menores suelen sonar tristes.(短調はよく悲しく聞こえる)
column2: A key that sounds dark or sad. In class: Las tonalidades menores suelen sonar tristes. (Minor keys often sound sad.)

column1: 高さのちがう音を同時に鳴らしたもの。授業では Toca el acorde de do con tres dedos.(3本の指で C のコードを弾こう)
column2: Notes played together. In class: Toca el acorde de do con tres dedos. (Play the C chord with three fingers.)

column1: 弦をはじいたりこすったりして音を出す楽器。授業では El violín es un instrumento de cuerda.(バイオリンは弦楽器だ)
column2: An instrument played by plucking or bowing strings. In class: El violín es un instrumento de cuerda. (The violin is a string instrument.)

column1: たたいたりふったりして音を出す楽器。授業では Los tambores son instrumentos de percusión.(ドラムは打楽器だ)
column2: An instrument played by hitting or shaking. In class: Los tambores son instrumentos de percusión. (Drums are percussion instruments.)

column1: 合奏や合唱をまとめる人。授業では Mira al director para seguir el tempo.(テンポは指揮者を見てとろう)
column2: The person who leads the orchestra or choir. In class: Mira al director para seguir el tempo. (Watch the conductor for the tempo.)

column1: 少しずつ大きくする。授業では Haz un crescendo hacia el final.(終わりに向かってだんだん強くしよう)
column2: Getting louder little by little. In class: Haz un crescendo hacia el final. (Make a crescendo toward the end.)

column1: 曲を作る人。授業では Beethoven fue un compositor alemán.(ベートーヴェンはドイツの作曲家だった)
column2: A person who writes music. In class: Beethoven fue un compositor alemán. (Beethoven was a German composer.)

column1: オーケストラのための、いくつかの楽章からなる大きな曲。授業では Una sinfonía suele tener cuatro movimientos.(交響曲はふつう4つの楽章からなる)
column2: A long piece for orchestra in several movements. In class: Una sinfonía suele tener cuatro movimientos. (A symphony usually has four movements.)

column1: 歌のことば。授業では ¿Te sabes la letra de memoria?(歌詞を覚えているかな?)
column2: The words of a song. In class: ¿Te sabes la letra de memoria? (Do you know the lyrics by heart?)

column1: 大まかにさっと描くこと。授業では Empieza con un boceto rápido a lápiz.(まず鉛筆でさっとスケッチしよう)
column2: A quick, rough drawing. In class: Empieza con un boceto rápido a lápiz. (Start with a quick sketch in pencil.)

column1: 明るいところと暗いところを描き分けること。授業では El sombreado hace que la manzana parezca redonda.(陰影をつけるとリンゴが丸く見える)
column2: Drawing the light and dark parts. In class: El sombreado hace que la manzana parezca redonda. (Shading makes the apple look round.)

column1: 近くを大きく遠くを小さく描いて奥行きを出す方法。授業では Usa la perspectiva para que el camino parezca largo.(遠近法を使って道が長く見えるようにしよう)
column2: Drawing near things big and far things small to show depth. In class: Usa la perspectiva para que el camino parezca largo. (Use perspective to make the road look long.)

column1: 果物や花びんなど、動かないものを描いた絵。授業では Hoy vamos a pintar un bodegón de frutas.(今日は果物の静物画を描く)
column2: A picture of objects that don't move. In class: Hoy vamos a pintar un bodegón de frutas. (Today we'll paint a still life of fruit.)

column1: 人の顔や姿を描いた絵。授業では Dibuja un retrato del compañero de al lado.(隣の人の肖像画を描こう)
column2: A picture of a person. In class: Dibuja un retrato del compañero de al lado. (Draw a portrait of the person next to you.)

column1: まぜて多くの色を作れるもとの3色(赤・青・黄)。授業では El rojo, el azul y el amarillo son los colores primarios.(赤・青・黄が三原色だ)
column2: The three colors you mix others from (red, blue, yellow). In class: El rojo, el azul y el amarillo son los colores primarios. (Red, blue and yellow are the primary colors.)

column1: 色相環で向かい合う、たがいを引き立てる色。授業では El naranja y el azul son colores complementarios.(オレンジと青は補色だ)
column2: Colors opposite each other on the color wheel. In class: El naranja y el azul son colores complementarios. (Orange and blue are complementary colors.)

column1: 画面の中での配置。授業では Piensa en la composición antes de pintar.(描く前に構図を考えよう)
column2: How things are arranged in a picture. In class: Piensa en la composición antes de pintar. (Think about the composition before you paint.)

column1: 絵の奥の部分。授業では Pinta primero el fondo.(背景を先に塗ろう)
column2: The back part of a picture. In class: Pinta primero el fondo. (Paint the background first.)

column1: 水でといて使う、すき通る絵の具。授業では La acuarela se seca rápido, así que trabaja deprisa.(水彩絵の具はすぐ乾くので手早く描こう)
column2: Clear paint you mix with water. In class: La acuarela se seca rápido, así que trabaja deprisa. (Watercolor dries quickly, so work fast.)

column1: 絵の具をまぜる板。授業では Mezcla los colores en la paleta, no en el papel.(色は紙の上ではなくパレットでまぜよう)
column2: The board you mix paint on. In class: Mezcla los colores en la paleta, no en el papel. (Mix the colors on your palette, not on the paper.)

column1: 形を自由に作れるやわらかい土。授業では Dale forma de cuenco pequeño a la arcilla.(粘土で小さなお皿の形を作ろう)
column2: Soft earth you can shape. In class: Dale forma de cuenco pequeño a la arcilla. (Shape the clay into a small bowl.)

column1: 立体的に作った作品。授業では Esta escultura es de piedra.(この彫刻は石でできている)
column2: A work of art made in 3D. In class: Esta escultura es de piedra. (This sculpture is made of stone.)

column1: 版を作ってインクで紙に写す方法。授業では Con el grabado puedes hacer muchas copias de un dibujo.(版画では1つの絵からたくさん刷ることができる)
column2: Making pictures by printing from a block. In class: Con el grabado puedes hacer muchas copias de un dibujo. (In printmaking, you can make many copies of one picture.)

column1: とてもすぐれた作品。授業では La Mona Lisa es una obra maestra famosa.(モナ・リザは有名な傑作だ)
column2: A very great work of art. In class: La Mona Lisa es una obra maestra famosa. (The Mona Lisa is a famous masterpiece.)

column1: 作品を並べて見せる催し。授業では Nuestras obras estarán en la exposición del colegio.(私たちの作品は学校の展覧会に出る)
column2: An event where works are shown. In class: Nuestras obras estarán en la exposición del colegio. (Our artwork will be in the school exhibition.)

column1: 0より大きい数。授業では I numeri positivi sono maggiori di zero.(正の数は0より大きい)
column2: A number greater than zero. In class: I numeri positivi sono maggiori di zero. (Positive numbers are greater than zero.)

column1: 0より小さい数。授業では Meno cinque è un numero negativo.(-5は負の数です)
column2: A number less than zero. In class: Meno cinque è un numero negativo. (Minus five is a negative number.)

column1: …,-1, 0, 1, 2,… のような数。授業では Zero virgola cinque è un numero intero?(0.5は整数かな?)
column2: A whole number such as -1, 0 or 2. In class: Zero virgola cinque è un numero intero? (Is zero point five an integer?)

column1: 分数の下の数。授業では Trova il denominatore comune.(分母をそろえよう=通分)
column2: The number below the line in a fraction. In class: Trova il denominatore comune. (Find the common denominator.)

column1: 0.5 のような数。授業では Scrivi un quarto come numero decimale.(1/4を小数で書こう)
column2: A number like 0.5. In class: Scrivi un quarto come numero decimale. (Write one quarter as a decimal.)

column1: 2乗するとその数になる数。授業では La radice quadrata di nove è tre.(9の平方根は3)
column2: The number that, multiplied by itself, gives the number. In class: La radice quadrata di nove è tre. (The square root of nine is three.)

column1: x や y のように、いろいろな値をとる文字。授業では Qui x è una variabile.(ここでは x が変数)
column2: A letter that stands for a number. In class: Qui x è una variabile. (Here, x is a variable.)

column1: 2本の線が作る開き。授業では Misura l'angolo con il goniometro.(分度器で角をはかろう)
column2: The space between two lines that meet. In class: Misura l'angolo con il goniometro. (Measure the angle with a protractor.)

column1: どこまでのばしても交わらないこと。授業では Queste due rette sono parallele.(この2本の線は平行)
column2: Never meeting, like the two rails of a track. In class: Queste due rette sono parallele. (These two lines are parallel.)

column1: 広さ。授業では Calcola l'area del rettangolo.(長方形の面積を求めよう)
column2: The size of a flat surface. In class: Calcola l'area del rettangolo. (Find the area of the rectangle.)

column1: 円の中心から円周までの長さ。授業では Il raggio è la metà del diametro.(半径は直径の半分)
column2: The distance from the center of a circle to its edge. In class: Il raggio è la metà del diametro. (The radius is half of the diameter.)

column1: 立体の大きさ。授業では Calcola il volume del cubo.(立方体の体積を求めよう)
column2: The amount of space inside a solid. In class: Calcola il volume del cubo. (Find the volume of the cube.)

column1: xが決まるとyがただ1つ決まる関係。授業では y è funzione di x.(yはxの関数)
column2: A rule where each x gives one y. In class: y è funzione di x. (y is a function of x.)

column1: 点の位置を表す数の組。授業では Scrivi le coordinate del punto P.(点Pの座標を書こう)
column2: The pair of numbers that shows where a point is. In class: Scrivi le coordinate del punto P. (Write the coordinates of point P.)

column1: あることが起こる割合。授業では Qual è la probabilità che esca testa?(表が出る確率は?)
column2: How likely something is to happen. In class: Qual è la probabilità che esca testa? (What is the probability of getting heads?)

column1: 全部たして個数でわった値。授業では Calcola la media dei dati.(データの平均値を計算しよう)
column2: The total divided by the number of values. In class: Calcola la media dei dati. (Calculate the mean of the data.)

column1: 物を押したり引いたりするはたらき。単位は N(ニュートン)。授業では Disegna una freccia per rappresentare la forza.(力を矢印で表そう)
column2: A push or a pull. In class: Disegna una freccia per rappresentare la forza. (Draw an arrow to show the force.)

column1: ふれ合う面で動きをじゃまする力。授業では L'attrito rallenta la scatola.(摩擦で箱がおそくなる)
column2: The force that slows things rubbing together. In class: L'attrito rallenta la scatola. (Friction slows the box down.)

column1: 距離÷時間。授業では Calcola la velocità media.(平均の速さを計算しよう)
column2: Distance divided by time. In class: Calcola la velocità media. (Calculate the average speed.)

column1: 電気の流れ。単位は A(アンペア)。授業では Misura la corrente con l'amperometro.(電流計で電流をはかろう)
column2: The flow of electricity. In class: Misura la corrente con l'amperometro. (Measure the current with an ammeter.)

column1: 電流を流そうとするはたらき。単位は V(ボルト)。授業では Collega il voltmetro in parallelo.(電圧計は並列につなごう)
column2: The push that moves electric current. In class: Collega il voltmetro in parallelo. (Connect the voltmeter in parallel.)

column1: 磁石の力がはたらく空間。授業では Usa la limatura di ferro per vedere il campo magnetico.(鉄粉で磁界のようすを見よう)
column2: The area where a magnet has an effect. In class: Usa la limatura di ferro per vedere il campo magnetico. (Use iron filings to see the magnetic field.)

column1: 物質をつくるもとになる成分。授業では Trova l'elemento nella tavola periodica.(周期表でその元素を探そう)
column2: A substance made of only one kind of atom. In class: Trova l'elemento nella tavola periodica. (Find the element on the periodic table.)

column1: 物質をつくる、とても小さなつぶ。授業では Gli atomi sono troppo piccoli per essere visti.(原子は小さすぎて見えない)
column2: The tiny unit that everything is made of. In class: Gli atomi sono troppo piccoli per essere visti. (Atoms are too small to see.)

column1: 水溶液が酸性を示す物質。授業では Il succo di limone è un acido.(レモン汁は酸)
column2: A substance that turns blue litmus paper red. In class: Il succo di limone è un acido. (Lemon juice is an acid.)

column1: 細胞が栄養分からエネルギーを取り出すはたらき。授業では La respirazione libera energia.(呼吸でエネルギーが取り出される)
column2: How living things get energy from food. In class: La respirazione libera energia. (Respiration releases energy.)

column1: 食べ物を体に吸収できる形に分解すること。授業では La digestione inizia in bocca.(消化は口から始まる)
column2: Breaking food down so the body can use it. In class: La digestione inizia in bocca. (Digestion starts in the mouth.)

column1: 親から子に伝わる特徴のもと。授業では I geni passano dai genitori ai figli.(遺伝子は親から子に伝わる)
column2: The part of a cell that carries traits from parents. In class: I geni passano dai genitori ai figli. (Genes are passed from parents to children.)

column1: 「食べる・食べられる」のつながり。授業では Disegna una catena alimentare del bosco.(森の食物連鎖をかこう)
column2: The line of who eats whom in nature. In class: Disegna una catena alimentare del bosco. (Draw a food chain for the forest.)

column1: マグマがふき出してできた山。授業では Questo vulcano è ancora attivo.(この火山は今も活動している)
column2: A mountain where magma comes out. In class: Questo vulcano è ancora attivo. (This volcano is still active.)

column1: 大昔の生物の死がいや跡が残ったもの。授業では I fossili ci raccontano la vita antica.(化石から大昔の生物がわかる)
column2: What is left of a living thing from long ago, turned to rock. In class: I fossili ci raccontano la vita antica. (Fossils tell us about ancient life.)

column1: 太陽とそのまわりを回る天体の集まり。授業では Nel sistema solare ci sono otto pianeti.(太陽系には8つの惑星がある)
column2: The Sun and everything that goes around it. In class: Nel sistema solare ci sono otto pianeti. (There are eight planets in the solar system.)

column1: 赤道から北や南へどれだけ離れているか。授業では Tokyo si trova a circa 36 gradi di latitudine nord.(東京は北緯約36度にある)
column2: How far north or south of the equator. In class: Tokyo si trova a circa 36 gradi di latitudine nord. (Tokyo is at about 36 degrees north latitude.)

column1: 三方を海に囲まれた陸地。授業では L'Italia è una lunga penisola a forma di stivale.(イタリアはブーツの形をした長い半島だ)
column2: Land with the sea on three sides. In class: L'Italia è una lunga penisola a forma di stivale. (Italy is a long peninsula shaped like a boot.)

column1: 一定の面積に何人住んでいるか。授業では Tokyo ha una densità di popolazione molto alta.(東京は人口密度がとても高い)
column2: How many people live in a given area. In class: Tokyo ha una densità di popolazione molto alta. (Tokyo has a very high population density.)

column1: 国内のものを外国に売ること。授業では Il Giappone esporta molte automobili.(日本はたくさんの車を輸出している)
column2: To sell goods to other countries. In class: Il Giappone esporta molte automobili. (Japan exports a lot of cars.)

column1: 外国のものを国内に買い入れること。授業では La maggior parte del grano in Giappone è importata.(日本の小麦のほとんどは輸入されている)
column2: To buy goods from other countries. In class: La maggior parte del grano in Giappone è importata. (Most of the wheat in Japan is imported.)

column1: 作物を育てたり家畜を飼ったりする仕事。授業では L'agricoltura è importante in questa regione.(この地域では農業が大切だ)
column2: Growing crops and raising animals. In class: L'agricoltura è importante in questa regione. (Agriculture is important in this region.)

column1: 都市・文字・国のしくみが発達した社会。授業では Le quattro grandi civiltà nacquero lungo grandi fiumi.(四大文明は大きな川のほとりで始まった)
column2: A society with cities, writing and government. In class: Le quattro grandi civiltà nacquero lungo grandi fiumi. (Four great civilizations began along big rivers.)

column1: 皇帝などが広い地域や多くの民族を支配する国。授業では L'Impero romano durò centinaia di anni.(ローマ帝国は何百年も続いた)
column2: A state where one ruler governs many lands and peoples. In class: L'Impero romano durò centinaia di anni. (The Roman Empire lasted for hundreds of years.)

column1: ほかの国に支配された土地。授業では L'India era una colonia britannica.(インドはかつてイギリスの植民地だった)
column2: A land ruled by another country. In class: L'India era una colonia britannica. (India was once a British colony.)

column1: ほかの国の支配から離れて自分の国になること。授業では Gli Stati Uniti dichiararono l'indipendenza nel 1776.(アメリカは1776年に独立を宣言した)
column2: Becoming a country free from another country's rule. In class: Gli Stati Uniti dichiararono l'indipendenza nel 1776. (The United States declared independence in 1776.)

column1: 国と国が文書で結ぶ約束。授業では I due paesi firmarono un trattato di pace.(2つの国は平和条約に署名した)
column2: A written agreement between countries. In class: I due paesi firmarono un trattato di pace. (The two countries signed a peace treaty.)

column1: 国民が選挙などを通して政治を決めるしくみ。授業では In una democrazia, il popolo sceglie i propri leader.(民主主義では、国民がリーダーを選ぶ)
column2: Government chosen by the people. In class: In una democrazia, il popolo sceglie i propri leader. (In a democracy, people choose their leaders.)

column1: 議会で選ばれる政府のリーダー。授業では Il primo ministro guida il governo.(首相は内閣を率いる)
column2: The leader of the government chosen by parliament. In class: Il primo ministro guida il governo. (The prime minister leads the cabinet.)

column1: 人が生まれながらにもつ権利。授業では I diritti umani di tutti devono essere rispettati.(すべての人の人権が尊重されなければならない)
column2: The rights every person is born with. In class: I diritti umani di tutti devono essere rispettati. (Everyone's human rights must be respected.)

column1: 国や自治体の仕事のために国民が納めるお金。授業では Le tasse pagano strade e scuole.(税金で道路や学校がまかなわれている)
column2: Money people pay for public services. In class: Le tasse pagano strade e scuole. (Taxes pay for roads and schools.)

column1: 国と国の間でものを売り買いすること。授業では Il commercio tra Giappone e Cina è molto attivo.(日本と中国の貿易はとてもさかんだ)
column2: Buying and selling between countries. In class: Il commercio tra Giappone e Cina è molto attivo. (Trade between Japan and China is very active.)

column1: 名詞の代わりに使う語(「彼」「それ」など)。授業では Sostituisci il nome con un pronome.(名詞を代名詞に置き換えよう)
column2: A word used instead of a noun. In class: Sostituisci il nome con un pronome. (Replace the noun with a pronoun.)

column1: 語や文をつなぐ語(「そして」「しかし」など)。授業では Unisci le due frasi con una congiunzione.(接続詞で2つの文をつなごう)
column2: A word that joins words or sentences. In class: Unisci le due frasi con una congiunzione. (Join the two sentences with a conjunction.)

column1: ピリオド・コンマ・クエスチョンマークなどの記号。授業では Non dimenticare la punteggiatura alla fine di ogni frase.(それぞれの文の終わりの句読点を忘れないで)
column2: Marks such as periods, commas and question marks. In class: Non dimenticare la punteggiatura alla fine di ogni frase. (Don't forget the punctuation at the end of each sentence.)

column1: 意味が同じか近い語。授業では Trova un sinonimo di questa parola.(この単語の類義語を見つけよう)
column2: A word with the same or a similar meaning. In class: Trova un sinonimo di questa parola. (Find a synonym for this word.)

column1: 文章全体で筆者が伝えたいこと。授業では Qual è l'idea principale di questo paragrafo?(この段落の要旨は何かな?)
column2: What the writer most wants to say. In class: Qual è l'idea principale di questo paragrafo? (What is the main idea of this paragraph?)

column1: 大事なところだけを短くまとめる。授業では Riassumi il capitolo in tre frasi.(その章を3文で要約しよう)
column2: To say only the important parts in short. In class: Riassumi il capitolo in tre frasi. (Summarize the chapter in three sentences.)

column1: 物語のできごとの流れ。授業では La trama di questo romanzo è piena di sorprese.(この小説の筋は驚きでいっぱいだ)
column2: The order of events in a story. In class: La trama di questo romanzo è piena di sorprese. (The plot of this novel is full of surprises.)

column1: 物語に出てくる人や動物。授業では Chi è il personaggio principale della storia?(物語の主人公はだれかな?)
column2: A person or animal in a story. In class: Chi è il personaggio principale della storia? (Who is the main character in the story?)

column1: 物語を通して伝わる大切な考え。授業では Il tema della storia è l'amicizia.(物語のテーマは友情だ)
column2: The important idea a story shows. In class: Il tema della storia è l'amicizia. (The theme of the story is friendship.)

column1: 物語を語っている人。授業では Il narratore racconta la storia in prima persona.(語り手は一人称で物語を語っている)
column2: The one who tells the story. In class: Il narratore racconta la storia in prima persona. (The narrator tells the story in the first person.)

column1: 「〜のようだ」を使わずに、何かを別のものにたとえる表現。授業では «La vita è un viaggio» è una metafora.(「人生は旅だ」は隠喩だ)
column2: Saying one thing is another thing, without "like". In class: «La vita è un viaggio» è una metafora. ("Life is a journey" is a metaphor.)

column1: エッセイの最後でまとめる部分。授業では Ripeti la tua idea principale nella conclusione.(結論でもう一度主な主張を述べよう)
column2: The part that sums up an essay. In class: Ripeti la tua idea principale nella conclusione. (Restate your main point in the conclusion.)

column1: まず全体を書いてみたもの。授業では Finisci la brutta copia entro venerdì.(金曜日までに下書きを終わらせよう)
column2: The first full version of a piece of writing. In class: Finisci la brutta copia entro venerdì. (Finish your rough draft by Friday.)

column1: つづりや句読点のまちがいを確かめる。授業では Rileggi con attenzione per trovare gli errori di ortografia.(つづりのまちがいがないか注意して校正しよう)
column2: To check for spelling and punctuation mistakes. In class: Rileggi con attenzione per trovare gli errori di ortografia. (Proofread carefully for spelling mistakes.)

column1: 人の前で調べたことや考えを伝えること。授業では Ogni gruppo farà una presentazione di cinque minuti.(各グループが5分の発表をする)
column2: Telling people what you found in front of them. In class: Ogni gruppo farà una presentazione di cinque minuti. (Each group will give a five-minute presentation.)

column1: 決められたテーマについて、賛成と反対に分かれて議論すること。授業では Il tema del dibattito di oggi è la divisa scolastica.(今日のディベートのテーマは制服だ)
column2: Arguing for and against a topic. In class: Il tema del dibattito di oggi è la divisa scolastica. (Today's debate topic is school uniforms.)

column1: コンピューターの機械の部分。授業では La tastiera e lo schermo sono hardware.(キーボードと画面はハードウェアだ)
column2: The machine parts of a computer. In class: La tastiera e lo schermo sono hardware. (The keyboard and the screen are hardware.)

column1: コンピューターを動かすプログラム。授業では Installa il software prima della lezione.(授業の前にソフトウェアをインストールしておこう)
column2: The programs that run a computer. In class: Installa il software prima della lezione. (Install the software before class.)

column1: コンピューター全体を管理する基本のソフト。授業では Windows e macOS sono sistemi operativi.(Windows と macOS はOSだ)
column2: The basic software that runs the whole computer. In class: Windows e macOS sono sistemi operativi. (Windows and macOS are operating systems.)

column1: 0と1だけで数を表す方法。授業では I computer salvano tutto in binario.(コンピューターはすべてを2進法で記録する)
column2: Writing numbers with only 0 and 1. In class: I computer salvano tutto in binario. (Computers store everything in binary.)

column1: 画像をつくる小さな点。授業では Se ingrandisci, vedi ogni pixel.(拡大すると一つ一つの画素が見える)
column2: A tiny dot that makes up an image. In class: Se ingrandisci, vedi ogni pixel. (Zoom in and you can see each pixel.)

column1: 問題を解くための手順。授業では Scrivi un algoritmo per preparare un panino.(サンドイッチを作るアルゴリズムを書こう)
column2: A list of steps to solve a problem. In class: Scrivi un algoritmo per preparare un panino. (Write an algorithm for making a sandwich.)

column1: 手順を図形と矢印で表した図。授業では Disegna un diagramma di flusso prima di programmare.(コードを書く前にフローチャートを描こう)
column2: A diagram of steps with shapes and arrows. In class: Disegna un diagramma di flusso prima di programmare. (Draw a flowchart before you code.)

column1: 同じ命令を何回もくり返すこと。授業では Usa un ciclo per disegnare dieci stelle.(繰り返しを使って星を10個描こう)
column2: Doing the same instructions again and again. In class: Usa un ciclo per disegnare dieci stelle. (Use a loop to draw ten stars.)

column1: プログラムのまちがい(バグ)を見つけて直す。授業では Facciamo il debug di questo codice insieme.(このコードを一緒にデバッグしよう)
column2: To find and fix mistakes in a program. In class: Facciamo il debug di questo codice insieme. (Let's debug this code together.)

column1: コンピューターどうしをつないだもの。授業では Tutti i computer di quest'aula sono sulla stessa rete.(この部屋のコンピューターはみんな同じネットワークにつながっている)
column2: Computers connected together. In class: Tutti i computer di quest'aula sono sulla stessa rete. (All the computers in this room are on the same network.)

column1: キーワードでウェブの情報を探すサービス。授業では Usa buone parole chiave nel motore di ricerca.(検索エンジンではよいキーワードを使おう)
column2: A service that finds web pages by keywords. In class: Usa buone parole chiave nel motore di ricerca. (Use good keywords in the search engine.)

column1: 本物そっくりのメールやサイトで個人情報をだましとる手口。授業では Non cliccare mai sui link delle email di phishing.(フィッシングメールのリンクは絶対にクリックしないで)
column2: Tricking people into giving their information with fake messages. In class: Non cliccare mai sui link delle email di phishing. (Never click links in phishing emails.)

column1: データを決まった人しか読めない形に変えること。授業では La crittografia protegge i tuoi messaggi.(暗号化によってメッセージの秘密が守られる)
column2: Changing data so only the right people can read it. In class: La crittografia protegge i tuoi messaggi. (Encryption keeps your messages private.)

column1: 名前・住所・電話番号など、その人がわかる情報。授業では Non condividere i dati personali online.(ネットで個人情報を公開しないで)
column2: Information that shows who you are, like your address. In class: Non condividere i dati personali online. (Don't share personal information online.)

column1: 作品を作った人がもつ権利。授業では Questa canzone è protetta dal diritto d'autore.(この曲は著作権で守られている)
column2: The right of the person who made a work. In class: Questa canzone è protetta dal diritto d'autore. (This song is protected by copyright.)

column1: 人のように学んだり判断したりするコンピューターの技術。授業では L'intelligenza artificiale può tradurre le lingue.(人工知能は言葉を翻訳できる)
column2: Computers that learn and decide like people. In class: L'intelligenza artificiale può tradurre le lingue. (Artificial intelligence can translate languages.)

column1: 体を動かすために縮んだりゆるんだりする組織。授業では Allunga i muscoli delle gambe prima di correre.(走る前に脚の筋肉を伸ばそう)
column2: The tissue that moves the body. In class: Allunga i muscoli delle gambe prima di correre. (Stretch your leg muscles before running.)

column1: 体を支え、内臓を守るかたいもの。授業では Il calcio rende forti le ossa.(カルシウムは骨を強くする)
column2: The hard part that holds up the body. In class: Il calcio rende forti le ossa. (Calcium makes your bones strong.)

column1: 骨と骨のつなぎ目。授業では Il ginocchio è un'articolazione.(ひざは関節だ)
column2: Where two bones meet. In class: Il ginocchio è un'articolazione. (Your knee is a joint.)

column1: 1分間に心臓が打つ回数。授業では Controlla la frequenza cardiaca dopo la corsa.(走ったあとに心拍数を測ろう)
column2: How many times the heart beats in a minute. In class: Controlla la frequenza cardiaca dopo la corsa. (Check your heart rate after the run.)

column1: 子どもから大人の体に変わっていく時期。授業では Durante la pubertà il corpo cambia molto.(思春期には体が大きく変わる)
column2: The time when a child's body becomes an adult's. In class: Durante la pubertà il corpo cambia molto. (Your body changes a lot during puberty.)

column1: 体に必要な、食べ物にふくまれる成分。授業では Le verdure sono piene di nutrienti.(野菜には栄養素がたくさんふくまれている)
column2: What in food the body needs. In class: Le verdure sono piene di nutrienti. (Vegetables are full of nutrients.)

column1: 筋肉や血をつくる栄養素。授業では Mangia proteine per sviluppare i muscoli.(筋肉をつけるにはたんぱく質をとろう)
column2: A nutrient that builds muscle. In class: Mangia proteine per sviluppare i muscoli. (Eat protein to build muscle.)

column1: いろいろな栄養素をほどよくとる食事。授業では Una dieta equilibrata comprende frutta, verdura e cereali.(バランスのよい食事には果物・野菜・穀物が入る)
column2: Meals with the right mix of nutrients. In class: Una dieta equilibrata comprende frutta, verdura e cereali. (A balanced diet includes fruit, vegetables and grains.)

column1: 体に必要な水分をとること。授業では L'idratazione è importante nelle giornate calde.(暑い日は水分補給が大切だ)
column2: Drinking the water your body needs. In class: L'idratazione è importante nelle giornate calde. (Hydration is important on hot days.)

column1: 気持ちや心の状態の健康。授業では Parlare con un amico può aiutare la salute mentale.(友だちに話すことは心の健康の助けになる)
column2: The health of your mind and feelings. In class: Parlare con un amico può aiutare la salute mentale. (Talking to a friend can help your mental health.)

column1: けがや急な病気のときにその場でする手当て。授業では Tutti dovrebbero imparare il primo soccorso di base.(だれもが基本の応急手当を学ぶべきだ)
column2: Help given on the spot to someone hurt or ill. In class: Tutti dovrebbero imparare il primo soccorso di base. (Everyone should learn basic first aid.)

column1: 関節をひねって痛めること。授業では Ha una distorsione alla caviglia.(彼は足首をねんざしている)
column2: An injury from twisting a joint. In class: Ha una distorsione alla caviglia. (He has a sprain in his ankle.)

column1: 暑さで体温が上がりすぎて具合が悪くなること。授業では Riposati all'ombra per evitare un colpo di calore.(熱中症を防ぐために日かげで休もう)
column2: Getting sick when the body gets too hot. In class: Riposati all'ombra per evitare un colpo di calore. (Take breaks in the shade to avoid heatstroke.)

column1: 試合のルールを守らせる人。授業では Ascolta il fischietto dell'arbitro.(審判の笛をよく聞こう)
column2: The person who makes players follow the rules. In class: Ascolta il fischietto dell'arbitro. (Listen to the referee's whistle.)

column1: ルールに違反すること。授業では Spingere è fallo.(押すのは反則だ)
column2: Breaking a rule in a game. In class: Spingere è fallo. (Pushing is a foul.)

column1: チームで順番に走ってバトンをつなぐ競走。授業では Passa bene il testimone nella staffetta.(リレーではバトンをなめらかに渡そう)
column2: A race where team members run in turn. In class: Passa bene il testimone nella staffetta. (Pass the baton smoothly in the relay.)

column1: 音符を書く5本の線。授業では Scrivi le note sul pentagramma.(五線に音符を書こう)
column2: The five lines that music is written on. In class: Scrivi le note sul pentagramma. (Write the notes on the staff.)

column1: 1拍分の長さの音符。授業では Una semiminima vale un tempo.(四分音符は1拍だ)
column2: A note one beat long. In class: Una semiminima vale un tempo. (A quarter note gets one beat.)

column1: 1小節に何拍あるかを表す記号。授業では Questa canzone è in tre quarti.(この曲は4分の3拍子だ)
column2: The sign that shows how many beats are in a measure. In class: Questa canzone è in tre quarti. (This song has a three-four time signature.)

column1: 音楽の一定の刻み。授業では Batti le mani su ogni pulsazione.(毎拍、手をたたこう)
column2: The steady pulse of music. In class: Batti le mani su ogni pulsazione. (Clap on every beat.)

column1: 曲の速さ。授業では All'inizio l'andamento è lento.(最初はテンポがゆっくりだ)
column2: How fast the music goes. In class: All'inizio l'andamento è lento. (The tempo is slow at the beginning.)

column1: ドレミファソラシドのように順に並んだ音。授業では Suona la scala di do maggiore.(ハ長調の音階を弾こう)
column2: Notes in order, like do re mi. In class: Suona la scala di do maggiore. (Play the C major scale.)

column1: 明るい感じの調。授業では Questa canzone è in tonalità maggiore, quindi suona allegra.(この曲は長調なので明るく聞こえる)
column2: A key that sounds bright. In class: Questa canzone è in tonalità maggiore, quindi suona allegra. (This song is in a major key, so it sounds happy.)

column1: 暗い・悲しい感じの調。授業では Le tonalità minori spesso suonano tristi.(短調はよく悲しく聞こえる)
column2: A key that sounds dark or sad. In class: Le tonalità minori spesso suonano tristi. (Minor keys often sound sad.)

column1: 高さのちがう音を同時に鳴らしたもの。授業では Suona l'accordo di do con tre dita.(3本の指で C のコードを弾こう)
column2: Notes played together. In class: Suona l'accordo di do con tre dita. (Play the C chord with three fingers.)

column1: 弦をはじいたりこすったりして音を出す楽器。授業では Il violino è uno strumento a corda.(バイオリンは弦楽器だ)
column2: An instrument played by plucking or bowing strings. In class: Il violino è uno strumento a corda. (The violin is a string instrument.)

column1: たたいたりふったりして音を出す楽器。授業では I tamburi sono strumenti a percussione.(ドラムは打楽器だ)
column2: An instrument played by hitting or shaking. In class: I tamburi sono strumenti a percussione. (Drums are percussion instruments.)

column1: 合奏や合唱をまとめる人。授業では Guarda il direttore per seguire il tempo.(テンポは指揮者を見てとろう)
column2: The person who leads the orchestra or choir. In class: Guarda il direttore per seguire il tempo. (Watch the conductor for the tempo.)

column1: 少しずつ大きくする。授業では Fai un crescendo verso la fine.(終わりに向かってだんだん強くしよう)
column2: Getting louder little by little. In class: Fai un crescendo verso la fine. (Make a crescendo toward the end.)

column1: 曲を作る人。授業では Beethoven era un compositore tedesco.(ベートーヴェンはドイツの作曲家だった)
column2: A person who writes music. In class: Beethoven era un compositore tedesco. (Beethoven was a German composer.)

column1: オーケストラのための、いくつかの楽章からなる大きな曲。授業では Una sinfonia di solito ha quattro movimenti.(交響曲はふつう4つの楽章からなる)
column2: A long piece for orchestra in several movements. In class: Una sinfonia di solito ha quattro movimenti. (A symphony usually has four movements.)

column1: 歌のことば。授業では Sai il testo a memoria?(歌詞を覚えているかな?)
column2: The words of a song. In class: Sai il testo a memoria? (Do you know the lyrics by heart?)

column1: 大まかにさっと描くこと。授業では Inizia con uno schizzo veloce a matita.(まず鉛筆でさっとスケッチしよう)
column2: A quick, rough drawing. In class: Inizia con uno schizzo veloce a matita. (Start with a quick sketch in pencil.)

column1: 明るいところと暗いところを描き分けること。授業では L'ombreggiatura fa sembrare rotonda la mela.(陰影をつけるとリンゴが丸く見える)
column2: Drawing the light and dark parts. In class: L'ombreggiatura fa sembrare rotonda la mela. (Shading makes the apple look round.)

column1: 近くを大きく遠くを小さく描いて奥行きを出す方法。授業では Usa la prospettiva per far sembrare lunga la strada.(遠近法を使って道が長く見えるようにしよう)
column2: Drawing near things big and far things small to show depth. In class: Usa la prospettiva per far sembrare lunga la strada. (Use perspective to make the road look long.)

column1: 果物や花びんなど、動かないものを描いた絵。授業では Oggi dipingiamo una natura morta con la frutta.(今日は果物の静物画を描く)
column2: A picture of objects that don't move. In class: Oggi dipingiamo una natura morta con la frutta. (Today we'll paint a still life of fruit.)

column1: 人の顔や姿を描いた絵。授業では Disegna il ritratto del compagno accanto a te.(隣の人の肖像画を描こう)
column2: A picture of a person. In class: Disegna il ritratto del compagno accanto a te. (Draw a portrait of the person next to you.)

column1: まぜて多くの色を作れるもとの3色(赤・青・黄)。授業では Rosso, blu e giallo sono i colori primari.(赤・青・黄が三原色だ)
column2: The three colors you mix others from (red, blue, yellow). In class: Rosso, blu e giallo sono i colori primari. (Red, blue and yellow are the primary colors.)

column1: 色相環で向かい合う、たがいを引き立てる色。授業では L'arancione e il blu sono colori complementari.(オレンジと青は補色だ)
column2: Colors opposite each other on the color wheel. In class: L'arancione e il blu sono colori complementari. (Orange and blue are complementary colors.)

column1: 画面の中での配置。授業では Pensa alla composizione prima di dipingere.(描く前に構図を考えよう)
column2: How things are arranged in a picture. In class: Pensa alla composizione prima di dipingere. (Think about the composition before you paint.)

column1: 絵の奥の部分。授業では Dipingi prima lo sfondo.(背景を先に塗ろう)
column2: The back part of a picture. In class: Dipingi prima lo sfondo. (Paint the background first.)

column1: 水でといて使う、すき通る絵の具。授業では L'acquerello si asciuga in fretta, quindi lavora velocemente.(水彩絵の具はすぐ乾くので手早く描こう)
column2: Clear paint you mix with water. In class: L'acquerello si asciuga in fretta, quindi lavora velocemente. (Watercolor dries quickly, so work fast.)

column1: 絵の具をまぜる板。授業では Mescola i colori sulla tavolozza, non sul foglio.(色は紙の上ではなくパレットでまぜよう)
column2: The board you mix paint on. In class: Mescola i colori sulla tavolozza, non sul foglio. (Mix the colors on your palette, not on the paper.)

column1: 形を自由に作れるやわらかい土。授業では Modella l'argilla a forma di ciotola.(粘土で小さなお皿の形を作ろう)
column2: Soft earth you can shape. In class: Modella l'argilla a forma di ciotola. (Shape the clay into a small bowl.)

column1: 立体的に作った作品。授業では Questa scultura è di pietra.(この彫刻は石でできている)
column2: A work of art made in 3D. In class: Questa scultura è di pietra. (This sculpture is made of stone.)

column1: 版を作ってインクで紙に写す方法。授業では Con l'incisione puoi fare molte copie di un'immagine.(版画では1つの絵からたくさん刷ることができる)
column2: Making pictures by printing from a block. In class: Con l'incisione puoi fare molte copie di un'immagine. (In printmaking, you can make many copies of one picture.)

column1: とてもすぐれた作品。授業では La Gioconda è un famoso capolavoro.(モナ・リザは有名な傑作だ)
column2: A very great work of art. In class: La Gioconda è un famoso capolavoro. (The Mona Lisa is a famous masterpiece.)

column1: 作品を並べて見せる催し。授業では I nostri lavori saranno alla mostra della scuola.(私たちの作品は学校の展覧会に出る)
column2: An event where works are shown. In class: I nostri lavori saranno alla mostra della scuola. (Our artwork will be in the school exhibition.)

column1: 0より大きい数。授業では 正数比零大。(正の数は0より大きい)
column2: A number greater than zero. In class: 正数比零大。 (Positive numbers are greater than zero.)

column1: 0より小さい数。授業では 负五是负数。(-5は負の数です)
column2: A number less than zero. In class: 负五是负数。 (Minus five is a negative number.)

column1: …,-1, 0, 1, 2,… のような数。授業では 零点五是整数吗？(0.5は整数かな?)
column2: A whole number such as -1, 0 or 2. In class: 零点五是整数吗？ (Is zero point five an integer?)

column1: 分数の下の数。授業では 找出公分母。(分母をそろえよう=通分)
column2: The number below the line in a fraction. In class: 找出公分母。 (Find the common denominator.)

column1: 0.5 のような数。授業では 把四分之一写成小数。(1/4を小数で書こう)
column2: A number like 0.5. In class: 把四分之一写成小数。 (Write one quarter as a decimal.)

column1: 2乗するとその数になる数。授業では 九的平方根是三。(9の平方根は3)
column2: The number that, multiplied by itself, gives the number. In class: 九的平方根是三。 (The square root of nine is three.)

column1: x や y のように、いろいろな値をとる文字。授業では 这里的 x 是变量。(ここでは x が変数)
column2: A letter that stands for a number. In class: 这里的 x 是变量。 (Here, x is a variable.)

column1: 2本の線が作る開き。授業では 用量角器量一下这个角。(分度器で角をはかろう)
column2: The space between two lines that meet. In class: 用量角器量一下这个角。 (Measure the angle with a protractor.)

column1: どこまでのばしても交わらないこと。授業では 这两条直线互相平行。(この2本の線は平行)
